key_insight: The FrontierOR Challenge tests whether LLM-agent workflows can design scalable optimization algorithms across diverse operations research problems.
engineering_relevance: Reliable agent-designed algorithms could reduce weeks of specialist effort for routing, scheduling, and network design.
method: Build agentic workflows that design, test, and improve optimization algorithms.
Stage 1 releases 60 audited problems in weekly batches of 15; Stage 2 adds new problems and unseen instances.
Evaluate separately in an isolated, open-source-only Main track and a timed Self-hosted track allowing any software.
evidence_signal: In FrontierOR's one-shot evaluation, the strongest model matched Gurobi within 1% of its objective and ran no slower on only 39% of large instances.
watch_item: The abstract reports a baseline and challenge protocol, not evidence that iterative agentic workflows overcome the scalability gap.
paper_title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
